capabilities: Sync notes, renames and deletes across devices in near realtime
Transfer only changed files to minimize traffic
Merge compatible edits and save unresolved ones as .conflict.md copies
Queue offline changes locally and deliver them on reconnect
Pair and unbind devices via PIN and set single-device write mode
disambiguation: Not a wiki or publishing tool; despite the name it only syncs vault files with an OWiki server.
extras: Ships without a server; users must deploy OWiki separately. README warns the sync logic is unvalidated at scale and may cause data loss, advising an independent vault backup. Not yet in the community directory; installable via BRAT from johnhom1024/owiki-sync.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid hosted service, so users who want multi-device sync through a server they control have no first-party option.

relations.evidence: Sync your vault with a self-hosted OWiki server via WebSocket.

summary: Self-hosted sync plugin that replicates vault notes and attachments across desktop and mobile devices through your own OWiki server over WebSocket.
